lines.line: The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
— DAY 85 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 3 Pawpaw; 14 White Oak Acorns (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Muscadine Grapes — named and noted.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"I left bandages where the path bends. Don't thank me. Just live."
(324 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU! — your showbiz fans"
Inside: Skull Helm
Plus 44 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
📦 Your showbiz fans voted: a wacky curio, gift-wrapped, no note. The note would have explained it. There is no note.
Jamie Meier reads the sky: clear tomorrow, freezing.
Riders from The Bloodied: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
The feast's fire burns low — the buff fades with the night. (Feasted expired.)
Rosa left 2 rawhides by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
"Can we talk?" Adaeze sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to Adaeze.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Shaker telling Adaeze about Jamie. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
Brian heads out to forage. "Out for a forage. If I'm late, start without me." The pantry won't fill itself.
Jamie heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
Rosa heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
Sari heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
The pacing in the woods fades — whatever was out there has moved on.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Rosa telling Lena about Adaeze. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.

— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Larry opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Lena eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows, and winter is listening. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−1,600 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Sunback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ SUNBACK! You're on your own.

(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")

💬 Adaeze: "Watch its right side!"

Jamie leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Sunback. Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunback: Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Fight from its shadow side — When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
"WE SAW THE PELLET. THE LITTLE STAR. POP IT IN, NEVER CHEW AGAIN! WE CAN DO THE SURGERY — WE ARE VERY GOOD AT SURGERY. (WE HAVE DONE IT ONCE.)"
"The REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
Brian walks out to serve Stonebridge for three days. Still ours — membership needs no presence.

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 1,266 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it.

With Haven grieving again, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 9,000 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

"Larry's gone." Adaeze looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Larry." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.

📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.

◈ THE WITNESS — You didn't come to negotiate. You came with a list. Every bribe, every buried plot, every "rounding error" — including theirs. The judges are about to be judged.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
You read them cold — no heat, no adjectives. The charges land harder for it. One of the judges flickers.
You let them speak. All of it. The courtroom respects nothing the way it respects a prosecutor who doesn't flinch at their own witnesses.
You refuse the quiet. "In public," you say, "or not at all." The precedent is set — the galaxy's court has a new first page, and your name is on it. The judges bow. It costs them everything to do it.
◈ THE WITNESS — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE WITNESS — "Read the charges."

The trial of the judges. You read every charge, and some of them flinch — actual flinching, from beings of light. Justice, at last, with an audience. The galaxy's court has a new precedent, and your name is on it. Your own ledger sits in evidence beside theirs. That's why it worked.
You learned how much could change when someone was heard all the way through. You did the difficult part and waited.
You kept the pauses where another person had found their own words.

◈ Adaeze Nwosu walks out of the light alone, which is how she walked in — with every charge read aloud and answered, the ledger closed and clean. The village endures, and the record stands: what was hidden is hidden no more.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.
